I'm just a supporter of a game developer. He mentions this issue with me, so i try to fix it. Here's the link to his question:
[104541: CanvasGroup's self_modulate stops working when Y-Sort is enabled](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/104541)

Other issues that may be relavent:
[97682: Self modulate doesnt works on canvas group with enabled y sort](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/97682)
[91922: CanvasGroup culls (disappears) too early](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91922)

> 2\. modulate problem.  I think there is no need to transfer modulate through `_collect_ysort_children`. While it doesn't change effort, this isn't a big deal.

It needs to be propagated, by removing it you're introducing a bug (modulations of the intermediate items between the y-sorted branch root item and the given y-sorted item are not taken into account). Simple example:

You're right. I misunderstood the modulate propagation path of ysort nodes..  I'm sorry to add to your workload.
To make CanvasGroup work with YSort you can add a child node2D to it and enable YSort in that node and everything else goes inside it.

> To make CanvasGroup work with YSort you can add a child node2D to it and enable YSort in that node and everything else goes inside it.

Thanks, it helps a lot! The game developer I support is happy to have his issue fixed in official edition.

This practice can avoid canvasgroup rejection.

> To make CanvasGroup work with YSort you can add a child node2D to it and enable YSort in that node and everything else goes inside it.

Is there a way to include nodes outside the canvas group in the y-sort? Example node structure (doesn't sort correctly):

* Node2D (y-sort enabled)
  * CanvasGroup (self-modulate) ← can’t enable y-sort as it breaks self modulate
      * ... nodes to be y-sorted
  * Node2D (y-sort enabled)
    * ... nodes to be y-sorted
Yes it should work, check you pivot, z index and if all parent has ysort enabled

This leads to the other nodes outside CanvasGroup y-sorting with respect to the pivot of the CanvasGroup node itself and not the individual nodes under it, since y-sort can't be enabled on the CanvasGroup node itself. Am I missing something here?
